title: Bottle of Rainbows
description: Adds a new potion that gives powerful potion effects
body: # Description Adds a custom potion craftable using interchangeable items of 6 colors (such as ores and dyes): red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple. ### Resource Pack Required # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 # Alternate pack My resource pack [Rainbow Dragon's Breath](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/rainbow-dragon-breath) adds the texture to the dragon's breath, if you would like the standalone texture without the datapack.
